_README: MCP-ready seed payload for the App_Settings form. After Phase 0 lands, I run a single ZohoCreator_addRecords call against form_link_name=App_Settings using the `data` array below. skip_workflow is included for hygiene — App_Settings has no On Add workflow, but this keeps the pattern consistent with the skill.

data.Description: Distance (m) at which passengers get the 'bus arriving' alert.
Off-route distance (m) that flags a route deviation.
Minutes the bus must be stopped before a breakdown alert fires.
Standby queue size that triggers a ghost-bus request.
Standby size for the early-warning Cliq ping (before ghost bus).
kg CO2 saved per km vs a single-occupant car.
Default route distance (km) when a Route has no Distance_Km set.
Fallback bus capacity when a trip/bus does not specify one.
Lateness grace (min) before a trip counts as late in the driver scorecard.
